notes: Investigated the EOA harvester bug further (v5.6.50 fixed its change-detection logic, but a live re-run still found zero changes). Root cause: NetApp stopped publishing per-model EOA/EOS dates anywhere this tool can reach -- the docs.netapp.com page it used to scrape no longer links to per-model detail pages (confirmed live, zero matching links), the 44MB PDF now linked from its sidebar turned out to be a bulk install/maintenance doc export with no EOA/EOS table in any of its 3,184 pages, and NetApp Hardware Universe requires customer sign-in. This is a data-availability problem, not a parsing bug. Rather than let the existing EOA data quietly go stale, added explicit disclosure everywhere it's shown: the EOA risk finding's description and remediation cause, and the Firmware Currency section's freshness indicator tooltip (previously implied EOA was live-updating). All now state plainly the date is a manually-maintained snapshot, not a live status.
